findings.text: non-blocking: the guard test is not committed to the tree — it exists only at the run's evidence path and in each scratch arm — so no repository test fails if this join regresses; the reviewed run records this under outside_scope because its fence excluded tests/.
non-blocking: the `# module.__file__:` line names the worktree module while the `# tree:` and `# cwd:` lines name the negctl arm, so the receipt contradicts itself about which tree executed.

non-blocking: the join fires before `_require_launched_record` validates the record's phase, so a Mapping carrying phase `queued` would still write the sidecar, which is wider than the commit message's "join only a launched record".

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 3dc7d3ff moves the join into `_launch_queued`, 7786ece4 gates it on `isinstance(launched, Mapping)` so a dispatch returning none still refuses, and ab617767 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks a test per launch path, the stored review at promotion, a red negative control, base and head arms under the run scratch with `pytest -n 8`, logs carrying revision and command and EXIT=, and scoped ruff; logs/head-gate.log, logs/base-gate.log and logs/negative-control.log record each of those.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that every launch of a queued plan review joins its composed sidecar; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:360 now takes the join inside `_launch_queued`, the one function all three launch callers pass through (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:519, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:459, ...:4192).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, three commits, the three log paths, base 4 failed/624 passed against head 2 failed/626 passed, the negative control, and records the unlanded test under outside_scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py and the evidence fragment; `git diff --stat 4da2af6..ab617767` names exactly those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the guard test lives at the run's evidence path and was copied into each arm, so `git ls-tree ab617767 -- tests/` shows no repository test that reddens if the join at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:362 is removed.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-gate.log ends `2 failed, 626 passed` and logs/base-gate.log `4 failed, 624 passed` over the same 81 files, so the added-failure count of zero is read from the receipts rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: the change keeps the module's own docstring-and-comment idiom at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:249 and uses `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`, already imported at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:16.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:362 takes the join where all three launch callers converge, so a yield or a backend move now writes the launched id as well.
justifications.reuse: the join reuses recovery_review_dispatch.join_admitted_plan_review (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:731) and its `_record_review_dispatch` writer instead of adding a second sidecar writer, and the diff adds no new definition.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the three declared paths, and the dropped `joined_plan_reviews` result key in reckon/crew/queue_admission.py has no remaining consumer anywhere in the tree.
